name: exprtlabs-codegen-workspace

scripts.build: ttsc -p packages/codegen/tsconfig.runtime.json && ttsc -p packages/codegen/tsconfig.tooling.json && ttsc -p packages/model-codegen/tsconfig.json && ttsc -p packages/openapi-to-ts/tsconfig.json && ttsc -p packages/ts-to-openapi/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:tests: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/clean-tests.js && ttsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.bench: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/benchmark/run.js
scripts.test:packed: npm run build:tests && npm run test:packed:run
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:tests && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.test:go: npm run build:scripts && npm run test:go:run
scripts.test:all: npm run build:tests && npm run test:all:run
scripts.test:all:run: npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:go:run && npm run test:packed:run && npm run test:browser:run && npm run check:react
scripts.check:react: npm run check --workspace examples/react-mobx && npm test --workspace examples/react-mobx && npm run build --workspace examples/react-mobx
scripts.generate:examples: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/examples.js generate
scripts.check:examples: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/examples.js check
scripts.docs:build: npm run generate:openapi-compliance && vitepress build docs

description: Generate OpenAPI from TypeScript controllers and generate TypeScript models and API clients, with validation, serialization and optional MobX integration.
